name: the Embodied Hand
note: Agent BUILD orders now travel within placement reach, confirm from the ordering body, and fail unreachable terrain honestly. Hash RE-PINNED a second time at drain (s2374) with a named cause per F-1441-3, and the era deliberately NOT bumped: the true-reel-show slice (EH-3) rewrote src/replay/AgentTapeReplay.ts into an AgentTapeReplaySession the browser can step, and touched src/game/Game.ts, src/ui/LanternShow.ts and two new src/replay files -- all inside ENGINE_SOURCE_INPUTS' 'src' entry, so the constant HAD to move. Era 4 remains the s2372 behavioural change and nothing else; the merge is why the constant moved. Prior era-4 pin was dbf8b14e.
